desk.headline: Latest results: Q2 revenue up 8% to RMB7.94bn, profit up 55% (reported 27 Aug); no guidance; Q3 results due 24 Nov
results: The 12 November filing is a Hong Kong share-change return, not results: Bilibili cancelled about 20.4m repurchased Class Z shares, cutting them to 323.9m. Q3 results are due on 24 Nov.
In Q2 (reported 27 Aug) revenue rose 8% to RMB7.94bn, led by advertising, up 28%; games fell 14% against a strong year-ago hit.
Gross margin rose for a 16th straight quarter to 37.2%; net profit rose 55% to RMB339m and adjusted profit 25% to RMB704m.
Daily users rose 7% to 116.5m, spending 113 minutes a day on average.
Cash and investments were RMB24.3bn; a new $300m, two-year buyback started in June.

guidance.summary: Bilibili gives no quarterly financial guidance; it kept its long-term targets of 40–45% gross margin and 15–20% operating margin.

points: Management expects ad growth to continue despite a tough economy; ads from AI companies more than doubled.
Games should return to growth in Q4, helped by a pet-catching game set for 17 Sep and a licensed strategy game due in Q4.
AI spending is set to add about RMB500m to 2026 research costs, mostly for computing power.
Long-term margin targets were unchanged; about $118m of shares had been bought back this year by the call.

reports.title: Bilibili Inc. Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

desk.headline: Revenue up 8% to RMB8.32bn and adjusted EPS of RMB1.85, both above estimates; ads up 20%; no formal guidance
results: Revenue rose 8% to RMB8.32bn, ahead of the RMB8.24bn estimate; adjusted EPS of RMB1.85 per ADS beat the RMB1.78 estimate.
Advertising grew 20% to RMB3.09bn and IP derivatives 15%; games fell 7% against a strong year-ago launch, though less steeply than in Q2.
Gross margin improved to 37.3%; operating profit rose 32% to RMB469m, net profit 7% to RMB504m and adjusted net profit 5% to RMB828m.
Users hit records: 123.5m daily users spending 121 minutes a day on average, with 394m monthly users.
Cash and investments were RMB25.7bn. Bilibili issued $700m of zero-interest convertible notes, using $300m to buy back and cancel about 4.9% of its shares.

guidance.summary: Bilibili gives no formal revenue or profit guidance in its results release. On the call, management pointed to a Q4 adjusted operating margin in the high single digits.

points: Advertisers are favouring spend with measurable returns; ads tied to AI companies nearly doubled and search ads rose over 50%, though AI ad growth is expected to slow.
Games should improve markedly in 2027: the pet-catching game launched 17 Sep, San Mou launches 24 Dec and RO3 follows next year.
AI spending focuses on video recommendation, search and creator tools; the CFO said computing outlays will stay within the company's means.
Management expects 2027 free cash flow to exceed 2026 and said it will keep buying back shares when the timing suits.
